stem: In LPS endotoxin of gram-negative bacteria, which component is responsible for the toxic properties?

options.label: A
options.text: Vitamin K alone without any endotoxin components
options.explanation: Wrong molecule; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Lipid A moiety of the LPS endotoxin structure
options.misconception: None; lipid A drives LPS toxicity.
options.explanation: OpenStax: lipid A is responsible for toxic properties of LPS.

options.label: C
options.misconception: Muscle distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: Hemoglobin A1c polymers measured in circulating blood
options.explanation: Wrong molecule; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Myelin basic protein deposits along central axons
options.misconception: Neuro distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong molecule; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: lipid A as toxic moiety of LPS.
